Title: Register (no address field)
Preconditions: None
Steps:
1) Open Register
2) Enter valid name/email/mobile/password
3) Submit
Expected Result: Account is created; OTP flow starts; no address-required validation.

Title: Login required for checkout
Preconditions: User is logged out; cart has at least 1 item
Steps:
1) Open Cart
2) Click Place Order
Expected Result: User is blocked and redirected/prompted to log in; no order is created.

Title: Address required for cart checkout
Preconditions: Logged-in user; profile address is empty; cart has at least 1 item
Steps:
1) Open Cart
2) Click Place Order
Expected Result: Checkout is blocked with message to set address in Account Settings; redirect option works.

Title: Address required for custom design submit
Preconditions: Logged-in user; profile address is empty
Steps:
1) Open Upload Custom Design
2) Fill required fields
3) Click Submit Request
Expected Result: Submission is blocked with message to set address in Account Settings; redirect option works.

Title: PH address autocomplete suggestions
Preconditions: None
Steps:
1) Open Account Settings
2) Type 4+ chars in Address field
3) Pick a suggestion
4) Press ESC / click outside
Expected Result: Suggestions appear; selection fills the textarea; ESC/outside click closes suggestions.

Title: Checkout with GCash selected
Preconditions: Logged-in user; profile address set; cart has at least 1 item
Steps:
1) Open Cart
2) Select GCash
3) Place Order
Expected Result: Order is created; order meta payment method is 'GCash'.

Title: Checkout with COD selected
Preconditions: Logged-in user; profile address set; cart has at least 1 item
Steps:
1) Open Cart
2) Select COD
3) Place Order
Expected Result: Order is created; order meta payment method is 'COD'.

Title: Free shipping promo recorded for 10+ qty
Preconditions: Logged-in user; profile address set
Steps:
1) Add items so total qty >= 10
2) Place Order
3) Open admin order details
Expected Result: Promo is tagged (free shipping 10+); admin shipping fee is enforced to 0.

Title: Customer uploads downpayment receipt
Preconditions: Order is in Awaiting Payment stage
Steps:
1) Open Order Tracking
2) Choose receipt image
3) Upload receipt
Expected Result: Receipt is saved; status shows pending verification until admin verifies.

Title: Cannot proceed to proofing without downpayment verification
Preconditions: Order exists; downpayment receipt not verified
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Attempt to move to Proofing/next stage
Expected Result: Action is blocked (UI and/or server rejection).

Title: Admin verifies 50% downpayment (DB order)
Preconditions: Downpayment receipt uploaded; order in paid/Awaiting Payment stage
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Click Verify 50% Downpayment
3) Confirm
Expected Result: Payment meta becomes verified_type=downpayment; order can proceed to Proofing.

Title: No 'Verify 100% Full Payment' path
Preconditions: Any order in paid/Awaiting Payment stage
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Inspect available payment verification buttons
Expected Result: There is no 'Verify 100% Full Payment' button; backend rejects verify_type=full.

Title: COD skips Awaiting Final Payment flow
Preconditions: COD order; downpayment verified; order in processing
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) From Processing, attempt to request final payment
3) Mark Ready to Ship
Expected Result: COD does not require final receipt; Ready to Ship is allowed without final verification.

Title: Customer cannot upload final receipt for COD
Preconditions: COD order
Steps:
1) Open Order Tracking
2) Navigate to any final-payment UI (if visible)
3) Try uploading final receipt
Expected Result: Final receipt upload is not shown or is blocked with message: balance due on delivery.

Title: COD completion requires 'Mark COD Final Payment Received'
Preconditions: COD order shipped; downpayment verified; final not verified
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Attempt Mark Completed
Expected Result: Completion is blocked until COD final payment is marked received (server-enforced).

Title: Admin marks COD final payment received
Preconditions: COD order shipped; downpayment verified
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Click 'Mark COD Final Payment Received'
3) Confirm
4) Mark Completed
Expected Result: Payment final_verified=true and amount_paid=total; order can be completed.

Title: Non-COD can request final payment
Preconditions: GCash order; downpayment verified; order in processing
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Click 'Set Awaiting Final Payment'
Expected Result: Status updates to awaiting_final_payment; customer sees final payment instructions.

Title: Final receipt upload + admin verify
Preconditions: GCash order in awaiting_final_payment
Steps:
1) Customer uploads final receipt
2) Admin verifies final payment
3) Admin marks Ready to Ship
Expected Result: Final is verified; order can proceed to shipping.

Title: Admin sets shipping fee for qty < 10
Preconditions: Order qty < 10; order pending approval
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Set Shipping Fee
3) Save/Approve
Expected Result: Shipping fee is saved; totals update; approval can proceed.

Title: Admin cannot set shipping fee > 0 for qty >= 10
Preconditions: Order qty >= 10; order pending approval
Steps:
1) Open Admin Order Details
2) Try setting Shipping Fee to a non-zero value
3) Save
Expected Result: Server rejects or forces shipping fee to 0; no bypass.
